description:
AI-powered UltraStar karaoke package generator (lyric sync, pitch, and BPM detection)

USKMaker generates complete UltraStar Deluxe karaoke packages from a YouTube link or local audio file. It downloads/prepares the audio, separates vocals, aligns your provided lyrics to the singing using local AI (WhisperX + forced alignment), detects pitch and BPM, and writes a ready-to-play UltraStar .txt package - entirely offline after setup, no cloud APIs.
[0.28.0] - 2026-11-01
Adicionado
- Atualizações automáticas OTA via GitHub Releases (tauri-plugin-updater). O USKMaker agora verifica automaticamente se há uma nova versão ao iniciar, exibe o botão ⬆ Atualizar (vX.Y.Z) no cabeçalho com resumo das novidades, valida a assinatura criptográfica Ed25519/Minisign (.sig) e baixa, instala e reinicia o aplicativo automaticamente em Windows (.exe NSIS) e Linux (.AppImage).
[0.28.0] — 2026-11-01
Added
- Automatic OTA updates via GitHub Releases (tauri-plugin-updater). USKMaker now checks for updates on startup, displays an ⬆ Update (vX.Y.Z) button in the header with release notes preview, verifies the Ed25519/Minisign cryptographic signature (.sig), and downloads, installs, and restarts the app automatically on Windows (.exe NSIS) and Linux (.AppImage).
